entities.name: Vasile Groapă
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vasile Groapă  is a retired Romanian heavyweight weightlifter. He competed at the 1980 and 1984 Olympics and won a silver medal in 1984. He retired in 1987 after an injury sustained while training.
